subject: Demo access blocked by guest permissions — alternate bridge proposed
body:
From: Ryan Chen <ryan@oliveops.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo on Wed — access problem

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for sending over the calendar invite. Kate and I tried to join from our GSuite account and got an error: 'You don't have permission to join this meeting' when clicking the Meet join button. The ICS looked fine but it didn't surface a working link. Can you resend or provide an alternate Zoom link? We need the demo Wednesday at 11PT — is there a fallback?

—Ryan

-----Original Message-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Sent: Tue, Apr 11, 2028 9:04 AM
To: Ryan Chen <ryan@oliveops.com>
Subject: Redwood demo invite (11AM PT Wed)

Hi Ryan — looking forward to the demo tomorrow. Attached the deck and calendar invite (invite.ics).

Join: Google Meet (auto-generated)
If that doesn't work we can use Zoom — I can reissue a Zoom link if needed.

Agenda:
- 15m quick intro & context
- 30m walkthrough (Live demo + Q&A)
- 15m next steps / procurement questions

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0197

Attachment: demo-deck-v2.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: invite.ics (ics)

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ryan Chen <ryan@oliveops.com>, Kate Lin <kate@oliveops.com>
Date: Tue, Apr 11, 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Demo — guest can't join Meet; propose Zoom bridge

Ben / Camila — Ryan's team can't join the Meet join button; looks like GSuite guest restrictions for their org. Can we provision a short-lived Zoom bridge for tomorrow and rotate the passcode? I'd prefer a bridge we host so we can keep the demo on schedule and not ask them to change their admin settings.

CC'd Ryan & Kate so they're aware we're moving fast.

Marissa

---
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ryan Chen <ryan@oliveops.com>, Kate Lin <kate@oliveops.com>
Date: Tue, Apr 11, 2028 10:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Demo — guest can't join Meet; propose Zoom bridge

Hi all — we can host via our Zoom bridge. Proposed workflow:
1) I will create a meeting and set host to camila_reyes@redwood.ai, enable waiting room, and set a rotating passcode.
2) Send short, one-line instructions in the invite body + the Zoom link.
3) If their SSO blocks, have them join via browser and admit from waiting room.

Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210 (passcode to follow via separate email)

I'll generate the link and rotate the passcode at 10:30 PT tomorrow morning. Ben, can you confirm we can brief EngOps to admit guests from waiting room if needed?

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ryan Chen <ryan@oliveops.com>, Kate Lin <kate@oliveops.com>
Date: Tue, Apr 11, 2028 12:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Demo — guest can't join Meet; propose Zoom bridge

Confirmed — EngOps will monitor and admit guests. Camila, please send the passcode via separate thread/sms to Ryan to avoid exposing it in calendar text. Marissa, please update the invite to the Zoom link (and keep the Meet link in the description so internal folks still have it).

Ben Carter
